Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Kunal - 11 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Anjali - 35 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Savitri - 66 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The bedroom - a big bed, a wooden cupboard

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Kunal stands in the courtyard. Anjali stands near him.]

Anjali: "Today feels like a good day."

[Kunal gives Mother a flower.]

Kunal: "Yes, all right."

[Kunal slips and falls.]

Kunal: "That's easy."

[Kunal hurts his knee.]

Kunal: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Suddenly it begins to pour.]

Kunal: "One more time!"

[A light drizzle begins.]

Kunal: "That was fun!"

[Suddenly the ground shakes.]

Kunal: "Okay, Mom."

Scene 2: The bedroom - Day

[Kunal is asleep in bed in the bedroom. Anjali stands near him.]

Kunal: "Let's begin."

[Kunal wakes up and rubs his eyes.]

Anjali: "I really enjoyed today."
